notes.title: Minako: Beloved Wife in the Countryside is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/784f7d5d82c7222a0833674137c706d822997b84.png

Hello everyone!

We are overjoyed to bring you the official release of Minako: Beloved Wife in the Countryside! It was a great honor for us to work on this classic game, and we’re celebrating the release with a special 20% off discount!

We wish you all a great time experiencing Minako’s emotional story, thank you so much for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820940/Minako_Beloved_Wife_in_the_Countryside/

Happily married couple Minako and Tatsurou trade the busy life in Tokyo for a nice, long vacation in the countryside. Visiting her husband’s hometown for the first time in her life, Minako soon finds herself charmed by nature’s beauty and the villager’s hospitality.

Should you enjoy the kinks we represent, consider joining us on Discord and follow us on our Steam Publisher Page for all the latest news and games from Saikey Studios!
